overview.description: The WisdomTree GeoAlpha Opportunities Fund (OPPG) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the WisdomTree GeoAlpha Opportunities index. The fund is an actively managed fund that provides exposure to companies of various market capitalization from around the world based on perceived opportunities from geopolitical shifts. OPPG was launched on Jul 8, 2025 and is issued by WisdomTree.
